home.heroTagline1: The estuary of the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem
home.heroTagline2: Discover · Install · Manage · Connect, all in one place
home.kitDescription: Carry deepSea in your pocket — remote control, project sync and plugin management.
home.kitLinkDesc: deepSea's own chatUI controls your local dsh over an encrypted RTC channel — zero open ports, zero re-implementation of the official frontend.
home.kitSyncDesc: Sync your workspace and chat history over the same encrypted RTC channel — consistent across devices, backed up and portable.
home.kitManageDesc: Inject into the dsh settings page for one-stop install/uninstall/update and security audits across profiles.
home.kitSecurityDesc: Sandboxed namespace allowlists, dynamic secure paths, second-factor confirmation for risky actions, audit logs, and derived sync keys that never leave the device.

home.featureCuratedDesc: Ecosystem highlights salvaged from the deep: one-click install
home.featureCommunityDesc: Blue Whale Community + Wave Crest Tavern, trending at a glance
